art_direction: 米白橄榄瞳 · 发呆仰望: 米白底，橄榄绿眼睛上望，神态柔和呆萌。
composition_variation: Soft warm ivory matte field. Muted olive-chartreuse irises and black graphic eye shapes. Daydreaming upward glance: two medium-wide rounded almond eyes with enormous pupils turned up and left, olive-green crescent bands at lower rims. Right eye slightly smaller and 5 percent higher. Thin irregular black upper contour, no long eyelashes. One small off-white vertical catchlight each. Tiny understated straight black mouth slightly left of center below eyes. Eye pair at y=0.50. No brows, freckles, blush or objects.
